mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_progress (user_id, book_id, progress) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{progress}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, book_id) DO UPDATE SET progress = excluded.progress
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY book_id
